title: Under Cabinet Paper Towel Holder 15-Inch Solid Brass Cabinet Mount | Prestige Regal Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade counter space and access with a solid brass under cabinet paper towel holder designed to mount neatly beneath cabinetry with left- or right-hand opening flexibility.

  • Space-saving cabinet mount: keeps paper towels within reach and counters clutter-free
  • Solid brass construction: crafted for enduring daily use
  • Flexible orientation: mounts for left- or right-hand opening
  • Clean installation: concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Coordinated style: part of the Prestige Regal collection (traditional/classic)

Specs

  • Overall size: 15-Inch L x 7-Inch H x 2.5-Inch W
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Cabinet mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Paper towel holder and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
  • Product weight: 3.2 lb
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Finish options: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors such as golden yellow, antique pewter, fire engine red, pink, and autumn sparkle.

_previous.title: Prestige Regal Under Cabinet Paper Towel Holder
_previous.description: Attractive design brings together a touch of style and efficiency to your kitchen. This solid brass paper towel holder can be mounted under the cabinet with a left or right hand opening and will accommodate the extra depth of today's super-sized paper towel rolls. This simple counter-saving design fits any décor, is easy to load, keeps counters clutter-free, and is available in 14 contemporary and traditional finishes.
